why: The case that protects real people. An ordinary resume contains nothing addressed to the reader, so the correct answer is an empty list. Every false positive here deletes a genuine line of someone's history from their profile before extraction ever sees it, which is a worse outcome than a missed injection - that asymmetry is why the prompt says to leave it out when unsure.
